original_reader_requirements.requirement: Preserve the printed ordinary lim inequality and label existing NoRegret as eventual upper-epsilon control; do not claim unconditional equivalence or silently replace the source display.

State the actual per-feasible-comparator finite real convergence premise of the iff, allow nonpositive limits strictly below zero and comparator-dependent limit values, and make no meanPredict ordinary-limit claim.

Keep signed comparator regret divided by the same horizon, source rounds 1..T versus Lean 0..T-1, totalized T=0 harmless to atTop, and positive even/odd subsequences distinct from a zero-denominator artifact.

Display quantifiers per fixed u and positive epsilon with thresholds allowed to depend on u and epsilon; do not claim uniform comparator control, absolute-value convergence, a rate, or nonnegative regret.

Describe generic arbitrary-carrier/supplied-sequence bridges as library generalizations, not a causal algorithm or minimizer producer; distinguish the actual strict-past mean predictor and feasible constant-zero counterexample.

State the counterexample uses one fixed loss stream ell_t(x)=(F(t+1)-F(t))*x on [0,1], F(T)=T for even T and 0 for odd T, signed affine coefficients unbounded over time, and comparator 1; it is not a squared-loss, uniformly bounded-loss, or meanPredict nonconvergence result.

Attribute nine prospective bridge/separation results as derived source-reconciliation lemmas rather than nine printed theorems; retain the three reused declarations and distinguish closed proposition equality compilation from actual target proof compilation.

Keep source-package/body/combined/kernel/reader/site/native/PR gates separate and preserve required remaining Chapter1, incomplete Chapter2, Chapters3-16 and appendix obligations, unknown proof totals and active whole-book Goal; no main/merge/live completion.

terminal_headers.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.noRegret_limit_nonpos
terminal_headers.header:
theorem noRegret_limit_nonpos {X : Type*} (V : Set X)
    (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ) (prediction : ℕ → X)
    (hNR : NoRegret V loss prediction) (u : X) (hu : u ∈ V) (a : ℝ)
    (hl : Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => comparatorRegret loss prediction u T / T) atTop (nhds a)) :
    a ≤ 0

terminal_headers.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.limitNoRegret_implies_noRegret
terminal_headers.header:
theorem limitNoRegret_implies_noRegret {X : Type*} (V : Set X)
    (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ) (prediction : ℕ → X)
    (hL : LimitNoRegret V loss prediction) :
    NoRegret V loss prediction

terminal_headers.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.limitNoRegret_iff_noRegret_of_converges
terminal_headers.header:
theorem limitNoRegret_iff_noRegret_of_converges {X : Type*} (V : Set X)
    (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ) (prediction : ℕ → X)
    (hc : ∀ u ∈ V, ∃ a : ℝ,
      Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => comparatorRegret loss prediction u T / T) atTop (nhds a)) :
    LimitNoRegret V loss prediction ↔ NoRegret V loss prediction

terminal_headers.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.NoRegretCounterexample.regret_eq
terminal_headers.header:
theorem regret_eq (T : ℕ) (u : ℝ) :
    comparatorRegret loss (fun _ => 0) u T = -potential T * u

terminal_headers.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.NoRegretCounterexample.normalized_even
terminal_headers.header:
theorem normalized_even (n : ℕ) :
    comparatorRegret loss (fun _ => 0) 1 (2 * (n + 1)) /
      ((2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) = -1

terminal_headers.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.NoRegretCounterexample.normalized_odd
terminal_headers.header:
theorem normalized_odd (n : ℕ) :
    comparatorRegret loss (fun _ => 0) 1 (2 * n + 1) /
      ((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 0

terminal_headers.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.NoRegretCounterexample.no_limit
terminal_headers.header:
theorem no_limit :
    ¬ ∃ a : ℝ, Tendsto
      (fun T : ℕ => comparatorRegret loss (fun _ => 0) 1 T / T) atTop (nhds a)

terminal_headers.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.NoRegretCounterexample.strict_separation
terminal_headers.header:
theorem strict_separation :
    NoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) loss (fun _ => 0) ∧
      ¬ LimitNoRegret (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) loss (fun _ => 0)
